Class JlmLanguageModel

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal.JlmLanguageModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
LanguageModel
public final class JlmLanguageModel extends Object implements LanguageModel
The board's JLM1 engine behind MCU.getLanguageModel(), in Java: it reads the model where it was loaded (JlmLayout), keeps its attention cache in a second block, and runs the transformer one position at a time, the computation of JlmInference in juno-lm step for step. Java decides everything: the file layout, the tokens, the layer and head loops, the picks and the fallback; the loops over float arrays run in ModelMemory and JlmRuntime, which are native on the board. Every buffer is allocated once, at its largest size, so asking and answering allocate nothing.

    • begin

      public ModelStatus begin()
      Description copied from interface: LanguageModel
      Loads the JLM1 model the build linked into the firmware, replacing any model loaded before. A program that calls this method must be built with -Djuno.lm.model=<file>, or the build fails. Returns ModelStatus.OK, or why it could not.
      Specified by:
      begin in interface LanguageModel

    • begin

      public ModelStatus begin(SdCard card, String path)
      Description copied from interface: LanguageModel
      Loads the JLM1 file at path on card, which must already be mounted with its own SdCard.begin(), replacing any model loaded before. The file is copied into PSRAM through a 1 KiB buffer, so call it once, at startup. Returns ModelStatus.OK, ModelStatus.UNREADABLE for a missing or unreadable file, or why the engine refused it.
      Specified by:
      begin in interface LanguageModel

      Description copied from interface: LanguageModel
